auditMethod: Assistant web inspection of indexed English-source Wowhead guides plus canonical Blizzard index generator/tests; direct Wowhead DOM blocked by JS challenge, no Chrome Translator API replay.

reusableIssueFamilies.name: Canonical Blizzard index sync drops source-only/target-only IDs
reusableIssueFamilies.evidence: The previous collect_pairs function used an ID intersection. An omitted source-only ID could hide a same-name collision from the official whole-name projection; the analogous search endpoint was already fixed.
reusableIssueFamilies.fix: Union index IDs with source/target names independently and guard partial index refreshes against mixing newly renamed names with stale counterpart locales; multilingual helper and synthetic cross-page collision tests.

heldOutFindings: Warrior and Priest rotation guides contain spell names mixed with prose; ID-based names remain the correct layer for official localization.
Brewmaster consumables and Feral gear contain many current-season item names; canonical item IDs should take priority over speculative sentence overrides.
Augmentation UI/Macros contains literal /cast, /cancelaura and import strings that must remain executable; DOM code protection is browser-only verification, not confirmed fixed.
Frost basics and other source guides contain upstream incomplete season placeholders; do not count these as MEZU translation failures.
Localized Wowhead variants contain English prose mixed with translated names and sometimes English plural suffixes; these are not MEZU-rendered output.
remainingVerification: Chrome Translator API, macro code preservation and DOM/rich-text reconstruction
Quantified novel issue rate on unrelated held-out pages over two consecutive cycles
reusedJargonVerification: Source phrase vs current fr player glossary only; not full translated DOM output.
